-- Test full query with RAWR calculation
WITH ab_trader AS (
    SELECT ab.patsim, ab.peercorr, t.tradereg,
           CAST(t.trading_performance->>'winpct' AS numeric) AS winpct_val,
           j.v::numeric AS levratio_val
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(t.trading_performance->'risklevel') AS j(k, v) 
        ON j.k != 'margpct' AND j.v ~ '^[0-9]'
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN ABS(patsim - peercorr) < 0.1 AND peercorr > 0.7 THEN true ELSE false END AS bool_val
    FROM ab_trader
)
SELECT bool_val, ROUND(AVG(winpct_val / GREATEST(1, levratio_val))::numeric, 2) AS avg_rawr
FROM flagged
GROUP BY bool_val;

-- Verify: check how many traders are in each group and their RAWR values
WITH ab_trader AS (
    SELECT ab.patsim, ab.peercorr, t.tradereg,
           CAST(t.trading_performance->>'winpct' AS numeric) AS winpct_val,
           j.v::numeric AS levratio_val
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(t.trading_performance->'risklevel') AS j(k, v) 
        ON j.k != 'margpct' AND j.v ~ '^[0-9]'
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN ABS(patsim - peercorr) < 0.1 AND peercorr > 0.7 THEN true ELSE false END AS bool_val,
           ROUND((winpct_val / GREATEST(1, levratio_val))::numeric, 4) AS rawr
    FROM ab_trader
)
SELECT bool_val, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(AVG(rawr)::numeric, 4) as avg_rawr, MIN(rawr), MAX(rawr)
FROM flagged
GROUP BY bool_val;

-- Verify winpct extraction
SELECT CAST(trading_performance->>'winpct' AS numeric) FROM trader LIMIT 5;

-- Check if any transactionrecord links to multiple traders or vice versa
SELECT trdref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM transactionrecord GROUP BY trdref HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

-- Check total rows after join
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg;

-- Check distinct traders in the join result
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg;

-- Check if any trader appears in both groups
WITH ab_trader AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg, ab.patsim, ab.peercorr
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(patsim - peercorr) < 0.1 AND peercorr > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as suspected,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (ABS(patsim - peercorr) < 0.1 AND peercorr > 0.7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_suspected
FROM ab_trader;

-- Check if any trader has multiple abhvreg entries
WITH ab_trader AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.abhvreg) as ab_count
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY t.tradereg
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ab.abhvreg) > 1
)
SELECT * FROM ab_trader LIMIT 5;

-- Check if any trader has mixed suspicion status
WITH ab_trader AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 AND ab.peercorr > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_suspected
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY t.tradereg
)
SELECT SUM(is_suspected) as suspected_count, SUM(1 - is_suspected) as not_suspected_count FROM ab_trader;

-- Compute RAWR per trader, then average by group
WITH trader_suspicion AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg, 
           MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 AND ab.peercorr > 0.7 THEN true ELSE false END) as bool_val
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY t.tradereg
),
trader_rawr AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg,
           CAST(t.trading_performance->>'winpct' AS numeric) / GREATEST(1, j.v::numeric) AS rawr
    FROM trader t
    JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(t.trading_performance->'risklevel') AS j(k, v) 
        ON j.k != 'margpct' AND j.v ~ '^[0-9]'
)
SELECT ts.bool_val, ROUND(AVG(tr.rawr)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rawr
FROM trader_suspicion ts
JOIN trader_rawr tr ON ts.tradereg = tr.tradereg
GROUP BY ts.bool_val;
